context: Business planning: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki on a new service.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business meeting; corporate vocabulary (ビジネス/業務/事務/センター) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しいビジネスを、立ち上げたい。
lines.en: I want to launch a new business.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: どの業務から、始めますか?
lines.en: Which operations do we start with?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まず、事務の体制を整えよう。
lines.en: First, let's set up the office structure.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 専用のセンターも、必要でしょうか?
lines.en: Will we need a dedicated center too?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 相談センターを、設けるつもりだ。
lines.en: I intend to set up a consultation center.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: サービスのレベルは、高く保ちたいですね。
lines.en: We want to keep the service level high.
lines.style: earnest office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: その通り。業務の質が、信用を生む。
lines.en: Exactly. Quality of work builds trust.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 事務とセンター、両方準備します。
lines.en: I'll prepare both the office and the center.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm resolved closing throughout
